sections.text: Personal safety equipment, safety goggles, and rubber gloves and rubber apron.

items: Personal safety equipment, safety goggles, and rubber gloves and rubber apron.
Cleaning articles ( fluid, rags .. etc )
Mobilgear 634 oil , Esso surrett Nx 5k gears and Mobilplex 47 grease

Torque wrench, wrench with different sizes, pressure grease gun, and feeler 
 gauge

Check brake lining for wear and tear and if 2 mm thick above or under rivets 
 should be changed
Carefully examine for broken wire strands and any other damages
Examine the ropes and grease it with Esso surrett Nx 5k grease
Check oil level of gear boxes and refill if necessary with Mobilgear 634 oil
Inspect and check tightness of bolts , nuts .
Examine the condition of flanges and anti-friction bearing seals

Examine the structure steel works for rust or corrosion and repainted if 
 necessary
Check rings and bushings for wear and tear
Clean bearings and grease it with Mobilplex 47 grease
Check tightness of coupling, screws

Examine gears for main hoist, axial travel and cross travel which in open 
 boxes and grease it with Esso surrett Nx 5k grease.

Place a copy of test results in the 
 crane data file.

Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection I1, to be performed every six 
months or when damages occur on any part as indicated by M6 in the title block
This crane is 
 used for 
 maintenance 
 work of the intake gates and for lifting and lowering the bulkhead gates in 
 front of the intake gates of the turbine unites.
